# Vendored

`jsQR.js` is `dist/jsQR.js` of [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) 1.4.0 as published on npm,
unchanged; it is under the Apache License 2.0, in `jsQR.LICENSE`. The page loads it as a classic
script, which defines `jsQR`.
